translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Ra Paeninoa Jesus Reen Pilate
Enoa nee oatosor moawugowug, oanongeer soamwoonin patere kkewe me mwaaen kkewe aar ra pwiungiuw wunuunun aar repwe niiy noa Jesus.
Ra geoni noa nge ra paeninoa reen Pilate, iwe iiy minne governor.
Maenoan Judas

Igiwe Judas, iwe efang noa menewaen Jesus, a giuneei pwe ra aettiweginiy pwe Jesus epwene mae, a ssiuwen aan niunniuwaen iwe a aesefaaeni ngaeniir soamwoonin patere me mwaaen kkewe aar faiun senaapiy we eniig.
Nge a aepesa pwe, “Ngaang iya monofit reen aaei fangenoa menewaen erhai mwaaen se monofit.” Iwe, ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Meeta faan ngaenigemaem? Feeori pwe oamw engaang.”
Judas a oatoranong senaapiy kkewe noan Temple we nge a noa, iwe a noa nnoma noa iiuwan.
Soamwoonin patere kkewe ra pwigi faiun senaapiy kkewe nge ra aepesa pwe, “Senaapiaen meoniun ccha minneen, nge e aenneew ngaeni aarh anniug pwe sipwe oarhuw nong noan senaapiaen Temple.”
Ra tipieew fengaen wooan senaapiy we, iwe ra meoni eew faniuw itan Potter’s Field, pwe eew nenien paeyieer waseona.
Ina minne ra aeita ngaeni pwe “Faniuwaen Ccha” toorito igina.
Iwe a pwae noa pwe ennet meeta we profeta Jeremiah e aepesa: “Ra pwigi eniig senaapiy silver, nepaen miniwe re Israel ra tipieew wooan pwe repwe pey aegini ngaeni mwaaen we,
nge ra naini senaapiy een ne meoni ngaeni Potter’s Field, taeppen miniwe Soamwoon e anniugiu ngaeniaei.”
Pilate e Kkepas Aeiyeg Ngaeni Jesus
Iwe Jesus a iu me mmwaen governor we nge a aeiyegiy Jesus pwe, “Een minne aar king re Jews?” Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Een minimwu wo aepesa.”
Iwe esa paniuwaeni no meeta kkewe soamwoonin patere me mwaaen kkewe aar ra aepesa pwe teren.
Iwe Pilate a aengaeni pwe, “Wose rongorong towunepaen kkepesaen oatuttur kkomwu ra oaturug rhag reen?”
Nge Jesus ese paniuwaeni mwo nge eew, iwe governor we a igin mwaar noa reen.
Ra Aettiweginiy Aaen Jesus Maenoa
Reen oanongaen oaton gupwunon Passover, nge governor egaen saeneti noa erhai rhooan kanepwus ina aeremas towunap re tingoar.
Nge noan oaton naan nge eno erhai rhooan kanepwus itan nge Barabbas, nge oanongeer aeremas nge re giuneei.
Iwe igiwe rhooa towunap kkewe ra maegin rhu fengaen, nge Pilate a aeiineeor pwe, “Iyo e oaw tipaeni pwe ipwe saeneti ngaenigaemi, Barabbas aere Jesus we re faingi pwe Kristus?”
E fasiun giuneei pwe ra fang nong Jesus nee paiun faaen itaen aar noanowo ngaeni.

Iwe igiwe Pilate e rhiuwen mooat wooan nenien mooaton apwiung we aan, nge niewe pwiuniuwan a fangenoa reen eew kkepas: “Esooar meeta wopwe feeori ngaeni mwaaen mwamwaai na, pwe noan aaei ttan nee pwoong we nge iya igin waeiraes noa faaen itan.”
Iwe soamwooniir patere kkewe me mwaaen kkewe aar ra igin aetemaeginiy ngaeniir aeremas pwe repwe tingoareei Pilate pwe epwe saeneti noa Barabbas, nge a niiy noa Jesus.
Nge governor we a aeiineeor aeremas pwe, “Iyo neeiir rhooa riiurhai een oaw tipaeni pwe ipwe saeneti ngaenigaemi?” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Barabbas!”
Pilate a aeiineeor pwe, “Nge meeta ipwe feeori ngaeni Jesus, iwe itaen Kristus?” Oanongeer noa ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Kurusuw noa!”
Nge Pilate a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta taeppen wegitaeg aenneew e a feeori?” Nge iir ra pwan oatomoga aar iyaekkepwas pwe, “Kurusuw noa!”

Igiwe Pilate a giuneei pwe esooar ipitan aan epwe kkepas ngaeniir, pwe ina nge epwene rhaepetae eew fitigogo, a pwigi rhaan nge a toafi paiun memmweer aeremas kkewe nge a aepesa pwe, “Esooar monofitiy reen cchaaen mwaaen een aan mae. Pwe faer aaemi.”
Aeremas towunap kkewe ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Cchaan epwe itto woamaem me wooar naimaem!”
Iwe Pilate a saeneti Barabbas ngaeniir, nge ra wirhiy Jesus nge a fangenoa pwe repwene noa kurusuw noa.
Sonotaw ra Aeni Aegekkaei Jesus
Iwe sonotaw kkewe naiun Pilate ra paeni nong Jesus noan imwaen governor, nge ra faingiir oanongeer sonotaw kkewe nge ra itto roangei noa oaron.
Ra pwiniti saengi mengaagiun nge ra aememmengaagiu ngaeni erheo mengaag ccha.

Iwe ra fiti eew mwaer saengi irae towfanfan nge ra ngaettae wooan rhimwen, nge ra pwan iseni nong efoarh soapwon irae noan pai mwaaenen; nge ra foatotiw me mmwan nge ra aeni fetaeneei aegekkaei. Ra gaen aepesa pwe, “Sirow woamw, Kingaen Jews.”
Ra oattuffa, ra pwigi irae we saengi nge ra wirhiy ngaeni rhimwen.
Nge igiwe ra moann me aeni aegekkaei, ra pwiniti saengi mengaag ccha we nge ra aememmengaagiu sefaaeniy ngaeni ikkiwe sipegin mengaagiun. Iwe ra paeninoa pwe repwene noa kurusuw noa.
Ra Kurusuw Noa Jesus
Igiwe ra nennoa, nge ra rhuungi erhai mwaaen itan Simon saengi Cyrene; nge sonotaw kkewe ra aengimaw ngaeni pwe epwe aiufera kurus we aaen Jesus.
Nge ra tooto reen eew pwiuneoi itan Golgotha, wewen nge “Nenien Peopeoi Rhimw”.
Igaan iga ra itto aiuniu ngaeni Jesus wine min nofit me meras. Nge mwirin aan nnaeri, nge ese mwerhaen iuniumi.
Mwirin aar kurusuw noa Jesus, nge ra itto aekkaerh dice pwe repwe inetiy minikkewe mengaagiun wooar.
Iwe ra mooat tiw igiwe nge ra pipiiy.
Wooan tae rhimwen ra aepperhatae aaemweoi foatofoat e pwaeritae meeta we ra tipi ngaeni, e iura pwe: “Ieei Jesus, Kingaen Jews.”
Iwe ra pwan kurusuur noa riiurhai rhooa mwoarho oaron Jesus, erhai me peig rhooapwuton, nge erhai me peig mwaaenen.
Aeremas kkewe re faaeraeg noa me oaron Jesus ra gaen aepesa aenneewa, nge re iurhiugi rhimweer
nge re aepesa pwe, “Een miniwe wo iura pwe wopwe fereeitiw Temple we nge wa aiusefaaeniy tae noan enuuw raaen! Aemenewoag aere een Naiun Deus, nge wa teeotiw me wooan kurus na!”
Epwan ina rhag wunuunun soamwoonin patere kkewe me sinsein anniug me mwaaen kkewe aar re aeni aegekkaei Jesus nge re iura pwe,
“A aemenewaar aaemweoi, nge ese mmwenen aemenewa oanongan! Saapw i miniwe kingaaen Israel? Aere epwe teeotiw saengi kurus naan igina, ina nge sipwe niugiuniug ngaeni.
E niugiuniug ngaeni Deus, nge e aepesa pwe iiy Naiun Deus. Iwe, sipwe pipiiy aere Deus epwe mwerhaen aemenewa igina!”
Pwan rhooa mwoarho kkewe mwo re tapweei reen kurus nge repwan aessaewa reen aar kkepas ngaeni.
Maenoan Jesus
Saengi nugunupaen oanowas a noa, a rorhappiung noa wooan oanongaen faniuw we noan enuuw konook.
Enoa enuuw konook nge Jesus a aekkepwas temoag tae pwe, “Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?” wewen, “Aaei Deus, aaei Deus, meeta wa nigitiaei noa reen?”
Aaemweoi aeremas kkewe re iu igiwe ra rongorong miniwe nge ra iura pwe, “A faingi Elijah!”
Erhai me neeiir a mwetekkaein fattapweto reen, a pwigi eew faerewa nge a rhirinong noan eew wine emwaenn, a iseni tae nee soapwon efoarh irae nge a aiuniu ngaeni Jesus.
Nge aaemweoi re iura pwe, “Weti sipwe pipiiy aere Elijah epwe itto aemenewa.”
Nge Jesus a pwan aekkepwas temoag tae faaen eew, iwe a fangetae ngeoniun.
Iwe nge mengaag we e tteoraeg noan Temple we mwo nge a taeringatiw faaen ruwowu, saengi wooan ittiw faan. A fanemwar faniuw, nge faai ra tiningaeg fesaeng,
nge paeyi ra sugaeg, nge towunap rhooa maenoa kkewe naiun Deus ra menaw sefaaen.
Ra siusaengi paeyieer nge mwirin aaen Jesus menaw sefaaen nge ra noa noan aepinoamw we e santus, igiwe pwuwaen aeremas ra noa giuneer me ee.
Igiwe soamwoonin sonotaw we me sonotaw kkewe re pippipiiy Jesus ra giuneei fanemwar me oanongaen minikkiwe a wen, ra igin riutae iwe nge ra aepesa pwe, “Ennetaen pwe iiy Naiun Deus!”
Epwan ssow rhooapwut ikkiwe re oawruruto me itaaw noa, ikkiwe re tapweeito mwirin Jesus saengi Galilee pwe repwe tipaengi.
Me neeiir rhooapwut kaan nge reno Maria Magdalene me Maria we ineer James me Joseph, me miniwe ineer mwaaen kkewe naiun Zebedee.
Paeyinoan Jesus
Igiwe a nee oatofaaef noa, erhai mwaaen naiwiis saengi Arimathea a itto; itan nge Joseph, nge mwaaeneei nge pwan erhai rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun Jesus.
A noa reen Pilate nge a noa tingoar miniwe oanongaen Jesus. Iwe, Pilate a aepesa pwe repwe ngaenneei oanong we.
Iwe Joseph a pwigi miniwe oanongan, a tiugiumi ngaeni eew mengaag pwerh ffeo,
nge a iseni nong noan paeyi ffeo we aan, iwe ekken me neeiin faai. Iwe a oasoagopeniy to efai faai gin temoag reen aesemaen paeyi we, iwe a noa.
Maria Magdalene me pwan Maria we erhai ra mooat saep ngaeni paeyi we.
Rhooan Poosun Paeyi we
Mmasetae noan raaenin we Sabbath, nge soamwoonin patere kkewe me Pharisees kkewe ra itto rhuungi Pilate
nge ra iura pwe, “Menap, aemaem aei maengiy rhag miniwe maan oatupwutupw naan igiwe e rhiuwen menaw e aepesa pwe, ‘Ipwe menaw sefaaen mwirin enuuw raaen.’

Fang mwaenioamw pwe sonotaw repwe posuw gacchiuw paeyi naan toori miniwe aeinuwaen raaen, pwe minni rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun resoapw mmwenen noa reen paeyi naan nge renoa mwoarhow noa minna oanongan, nge ra noa aengaeniir aeremas pwe a menaw sefaaen saengi maenoa. Kkepas oatupwutupw een nge e igin oarosan aenneew saengi iwe mmwan.”
Pilate a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw pwigiir sonotaw repwe noa posuw gacchiuw paeyi naan.”
Iwe ra noa nge ra noa ammwarhiu gacchiuw noa fai we tittin paeyi we, nge ra siusaengi aaemweoi sonotaw pwe epwe posuw.
